retention.stated: the assigned hostname is unusable, so nothing is served for any period

egress.terms: not published; the assigned hostname resolves to 0.0.0.0 and ::, so no byte is reachable

chaining: composes with nothing: the SSH leg succeeds and the HTTP leg has no DNS record.

anonymous raw TCP: one random port for 10 minutes, two connections, 256 KiB/s cap; with a key: 30 minutes, five connections, 1 MiB/s
public TCP and UDP forwarding are paid-only

identity_cost.detail: the ssh target needs no account; a key is optional for reserved names

notes: Re-read 2026-10-23: the product now has a free WireGuard peer generator at wg.serveo.net:51820 and a paid Pro plan at $60/yr. Free tiers get an HTTP hostname over WireGuard or SSH only; raw public TCP and UDP are paid. See findings for the quotes.
